name: plugin-mythos
description: Create presentations, websites, landing pages and interactive lessons rendered live inside ChatGPT, with a shareable link, HTML download and PDF printing.

interface.shortDescription: Slides, sites and interactive lessons rendered in the chat
interface.longDescription: Mythos turns ChatGPT into a presentation and web design studio. It plans with a design brief, renders decks (18 layouts, animated charts, quizzes, flip cards, speaker notes), websites and landing pages (hero, features, pricing, FAQ, testimonials, forms) and fully custom interactive HTML directly in the conversation, then gives a shareable link that opens fullscreen, downloads a self-contained HTML file and prints to PDF.
defaultPrompt: Crie uma apresentação de 10 slides sobre o Modernismo brasileiro para o ensino médio
Crie uma landing page para o meu curso online de escrita
Monte um quiz interativo de 8 perguntas sobre frações
